**Triage: lands in the test files that spawn a child vitest (enumerated below); `domain:devx` because they span packages and `scripts/`; `priority:p2` because it makes a whole class of pins verify a byte stream CI never sees.**

### Why p2 and not p3 — the trap is that the obvious reproduction does not reproduce

Measured, one tree, one command:

| child env | escape bytes | the ANSI-fragile assertion |
|---|---|---|
| as the container gives it | **0** | **passes** |
| `env -u CLAUDECODE -u AI_AGENT` | **264** | **fails, identically to CI** |

⚠️ **`CI=true` / `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` does NOT reproduce it** — that was tried first and stayed green. ⇒ an author doing the sensible thing (imitate CI locally) gets a green that means nothing, and the pin they write is verified against the wrong stream. A defect that punishes the correct instinct is worth more than p3.

Mechanism: vitest calls `disableDefaultColors()` when std-env's `isAgent` is true; an agent container sets `CLAUDECODE` and `AI_AGENT`, and a spawned child **inherits** them. Scrubbing only `VITEST`-prefixed keys — the natural thing to write, and what PR #8588's pin did — does not clear them.

### Population, enumerated on `origin/main` rather than described

`git grep -l -E "spawn.*vitest|execa.*vitest"` returns, among others: `packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts`, `packages/create-plugin/src/__tests__/cli-cancel-and-nontty-8786.test.ts`, `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-subpath-bundle-config-8598.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/dist-pins-guard-message-8274.test.ts`, and both `scripts/__tests__/network-escape-worker-coverage-8537.escape-*.test.ts` (the pair this was found from). ⚠️ That grep matches two spellings only — **re-derive the population before fixing**; a spawner written a third way is invisible to it, and this card's own claim about scope is a PM reading, not a census.

⇒ Preferred shape: make the child environment deterministic for every such spawn (one shared helper), rather than patching each assertion. ⛔ Do not fix it by loosening the assertions to accept either byte stream — that discards the very thing the pins exist to check.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — the helper is small; establishing the true population is the work.

**Shape, per the ruling at 5619251332**: make the child environment **deterministic for every such spawn**, through **one shared helper**. ⛔ Do **not** patch each assertion, and ⛔ **never** loosen an assertion to accept either byte stream — that discards the very thing the pins exist to check.

⚠️ **Re-derive the population; ⛔ do not inherit it.** Triage says so in its own words: its `git grep` matches **two spellings only**, and a spawner written a third way is invisible to it. This seat's own read of that grep on `origin/main` `4d65991c5` (**tip committed 2026-09-10T15:31:10Z**) returns six files, and ⛔ that is a starting point, not a census.

⚠️ One of those six — `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-subpath-bundle-config-8598.test.ts` — was changed **today** by PR objectui#8985 (objectui#8590, landed `db75e8331`), which scrubs a different variable across one dynamic import in it. ⇒ branch off the **merged** `main` and read that repair before touching the file; ⭐ it is the same family of problem — a child context inheriting something the parent's environment implied — and its shape is worth reusing rather than colliding with.

**Fold-or-serial**: objectui#8606 rides in the same batch and its file face is **disjoint** from this one — `comm -12` over the two sorted sets returns nothing. ⇒ parallel, ⛔ not serial.

⛔ Fenced OFF: the assertions themselves · ⛔ any pin's coverage or threshold · ⛔ objectui#8606's pin family · ⛔ `content/docs/releases/**`.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#8997, and ⭐ the triage grep turned out to be **1-for-6**

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-10T16:22Z. Verified against the tree.

`origin/main` = `4d65991c5`, **tip committed 2026-09-10T15:31:10Z**; head `42cd38892`, **committed 16:09:32Z**. Seven files, **+421 / −30**. No model identifier in the commits.

### ⭐ The population, and why "re-derive it" was not a formality

Triage handed over six files with the warning that its grep matched two spellings only. The dev re-derived and the result is worse than 「incomplete」:

⇒ **five of the six match a COMMENT.** The filename `spawned-build-vitest-env-8598.test.ts` carries both `spawn` and `vitest` on one line, so every file merely *naming* it matched. Two of those five are the escape **fixtures**, which spawn nothing — and ⭐ **the file that actually spawns them was not in the six at all.** Exactly one of six was a real member.

The real population is **4**, established by an **AST census**: 2,964 test files parsed, 311 spawn calls found, filtered to vitest, with a control at every step — including one that confirms the census finds the member the grep missed. Two further sweeps (transitive spawners; a repo-wide binary-name sweep) each carried their own control and returned nothing new.

⇒ ⛔ the six was not a population, it was a string match. ⭐ A card's own scope claim is a premise like any other, and triage said so in its own words — 「this card's claim about scope is a PM reading, not a census」.

### The fence this seat would have refused the pull request over, checked by measurement

⛔ 「Never loosen an assertion to accept either byte stream.」 The whole-diff count showed **9** assertion lines, which is exactly the shape that looks like a violation — so this seat split it per file:

| file | assertion lines in the diff | before → after |
|:--|--:|:--|
| the four pre-existing pin files | **0** each | 197→197 · 15→15 · 12→12 · 8→8 |
| the NEW gate file | 9 | (new) |

⇒ ⭐ **all nine are in the new gate.** Not one assertion in the four pinned files was added, removed or edited, and their counts are stable. ⛔ A whole-diff count answered a per-file question; splitting it settled it.

### ⭐ The fix proof is the right shape

Five reproduction readings, one command, only the environment varying — and the last one is the one that matters: with the **shipped helper** and ⛔ no `env -u` anywhere, the child emits **264** escape sequences and the pin fails on RAW bytes exactly as CI does. ⇒ the assertion now passes **because of `stripAnsi`**, which is exercised locally for the first time — ⛔ not by accident.

Two ablation legs on the committed tree, each with grep counts in both directions, a blob hash differing from `HEAD`, a trap restore, and an **empty `git diff HEAD`** as the proof of restoration.

### ⭐ Three findings that outlive the card

1. **`FORCE_COLOR=1` is inert** — one of the card's own three candidate remedies. Mechanism, not opinion: `disableDefaultColors()` is `Object.assign(palette, getDefaultColors())`, which **overwrites** the palette `FORCE_COLOR` had already been consulted to build. ⇒ anyone reaching for it would get a green that means nothing.
2. **`isAgent` reaches far past colour.** In this vitest it also swaps the default reporter to `agent`, changes coverage defaults, and turns watch off. ⇒ a spawned vitest in an agent container is a **differently configured program**, ⛔ not the same run uncoloured — which widens the card rather than closing it.
3. ⚠️ **The one case the helper cannot reach, handled loudly.** std-env probes `PATH`, and `PATH` cannot be deleted from a child that must still run — so on one class of agent host a non-agent child is unreachable. ⛔ The dev refused to paper over it: the gate's live control asserts the produced environment really **is** read as a non-agent, so such a host goes **red at the gate** rather than quietly producing the wrong byte stream downstream. ⭐ That is the correct direction for an unfixable case, and the asymmetry is flagged rather than decided silently.

⛔ Fences held: the sibling's file set is disjoint (**0** overlap, measured); no coverage figure or threshold touched; `content/docs/releases/**` untouched; a changeset added with empty frontmatter as the first-class spelling for a test-only change, after the gate said none was owed.

⚠️ **Owed by this seat, from the report** — recorded so they are not lost, ⛔ and not folded in: two `not.toContain` assertions in a pinned file are the vacuous shape this card itself calls its grading-relevant question (green today, and the strings are ones vitest does not colour); and a bash-script-plus-turbo spawn in a doc-snippet test is the same family with a different runner.

⇒ Landing pipeline: CI on `42cd38892`, then flip ready, **post-flip** guard read, `SQUASH`, queue confirm from the timeline event, the landing probe written **before** the merge, merge, probe, LANDED.
